name: savemit-security
description: Validated npm dependency-vulnerability investigation for Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Validate npm vulnerability remediations before proposing changes.
interface.longDescription: SAVEMit scans a local Node/npm repository, investigates vulnerable dependencies, and validates proposed upgrades in an isolated Docker container. It never edits or merges the target repository.
defaultPrompt: Use SAVEMit to investigate npm dependency vulnerabilities in this repository.
Run SAVEMit and summarize the validated remediation options.
